# Independent science review: full bilingual Introduction candidate

Status: CONDITIONAL PASS pending N07 and N23 corrections/recheck. Read all23 EN/ZH original/candidate sentence pairs in candidate_sentences.json, prior complete Introduction from old_paper_en/zh.tex, existing unchanged figure caption, and the actual Token-Picker author-v1 physical page1 Introduction (both columns). No repository edits by reviewer. This is substantive source/claim review; build/layout and full output acceptance remain separate.

## Reference use

Actually opened reference-p1.png and read the Introduction beginning at its true section heading, not the abstract. It moves from application/inference context, through memory-access pressure and prior approaches' limitations, to its mechanism and enumerated measured contributions. The candidate appropriately transfers problem→selection gap→design→evaluation organization, not Token-Picker's numerical speedup, pruning guarantees, near-zero token condition or bespoke hardware causal evidence. Existing award/author-version provenance is inherited; this is no new bibliography search or full-paper reading.

## Required scoped corrections

SCI-INTRO-01 N07: explicitly restrict extrema bound to individual UNQUANTIZED token scores in the same scoring coordinates. Current phrasing omits a condition present in old Introduction and Method. Independently quantized scores and original-dimensional logits are not bounded by that construction as currently proven. Suggested EN: 'Mean pooling can dilute an isolated high token score, while sign-aware extrema provide a potentially loose upper bound on individual unquantized token scores in the scoring coordinates; neither ranks pages by their total attention weight.' ZH: '均值池化可能稀释孤立的高词元分数，符号感知极值则对同一评分坐标内未量化的单词元分数给出可能较松的上界；二者都不按页内注意力权重总和排序。'

SCI-INTRO-02 N23: current closure says coverage and selector overhead must be evaluated together before quality–latency benefit. Those are proxies/components, not the full necessary acceptance criterion. Restore matched task quality and complete-request cost, including preparation/selection. Suggested EN: 'Task quality and complete-request cost, including preparation and selection, must therefore be measured under matched conditions before claiming a quality--latency benefit for the compact 4/128-protection design.' ZH: '因此，需在匹配条件下联合测量任务质量与包含准备、选择在内的完整请求成本，才能声称紧凑4/128保护设计具有质量--时延收益。' This is a concise scientific closure, not an audit checklist.

## Sentence-by-sentence disposition

N01–N04 PASS: natural decoding context and selection overhead problem. N03 is a desired net-benefit condition, not asserted achievement. N04 bilingual wording differs rhetorically but carries the same importance of selection and final-set size.
N05 PASS with existing citation scope: credits page-to-token precedent, avoiding invented novelty. This review does not newly establish official AsyncTLS code availability or matched comparative performance.
N06 PASS: possibility of coarse approximation misses, no guaranteed monotonic fidelity.
N07 required correction above.
N08–N10 PASS numeric/scope: one profiled query, mass-rank reference, no task-quality ranking. Unchanged caption importantly retains same32pages but1989/1989/2048realized tokens, shared32scoring coordinates versus full-dimensional mass reference, and non-oracle boundary. Keep that caption; do not infer equal work or causal superiority from miss counts.
N11–N14 PASS in context: global allocation need not reserve a region, positive regional reservations retain capacity, and page admission alone does not reserve final token slots. N13 remains a diagnostic reservation experiment, not the production selector or an independent128sample statistical study. Avoid interpreting N12 as a guarantee that any chosen production beta/gamma/K yields positive far-token quota; N14 already counters that inference.
N15–N19 PASS: defined shared-coordinate design, separate page/token budgets, original-dimensional retained attention, ordinary full-history L2 work, optional default-off gate. N16 describes compact candidate, not proof all historical quality runs used compact actual widths. No 'lossless' or measured net acceleration claim. Removing older coordinate-confounding explanation from Introduction is acceptable because unchanged caption/S1 retain random32 pairing limitation; no new causal frequency claim added.
N20 PASS: contributions phrased as formulation/analysis/evaluation rather than first-ever invention, established superiority or recovered empirical guarantee.
N21 PASS numeric and bilingual meaning; optional clarity improvement: state the8B configurations jointly change page/token allocation, not beta as an isolated causal variable. Current N22already disclaims causal isolation, so this is not mandatory. These are two DISTINCT comparisons:8B sparse-vs-sparse and32B sparse-vs-dense, not one cross-scale ablation or common-quality point. No8B dense/scorer equivalence is asserted here.
N22 PASS: preserves descriptive status and negative sparse-decoding result over its measured lengths; 'archived' prevents transfer to compact candidate.
N23 required correction above.

## Direct numerical verification

From frozen remote_observation_input.json representative pages, independently computed32reference pages,13mean misses and17extrema misses; missed-mass shares59.64750561826472% and26.4599446933513%, matching59.65/26.46%. From128stored regional records, recomputed .6759161456719791 and .7207055160037678 means and43lower-retention cases. These are aggregate recomputations, not new traces.

Loaded original e146c/e147c/e143a score JSONs:8B58.30 vs59.290909090909096 gives+.990909...;32B50.64272727272728 vs52.21818181818182 gives-1.5754545.... N21rounding+.99/-1.58correct; science_numbers.json. Complete11task scope is retained. Prior manifest-level identity evidence and raw-replay limits remain; no new paired prediction validation or inference interval produced.

## Negative results, natural prose and acceptance

Candidate preserves local/full-history work caveat and slower historical decode; historical128K loss remains in body/caption-linked evidence, and no new suppression identified. Its story is materially clearer and less repetitive than the prior Introduction: motivation and observation lead into explicit design and a modest contribution statement. Keep detailed record identities out of these sentences; concise N07condition and matched whole-cost closure are sufficient. No new benchmark/scorer/tool readiness or four-wins inference.

Recheck requested: author submits revised N07/N23 bilingual sentences, with all other result/figure-caption boundaries unchanged. Then scientific source acceptance can pass, separately from actual PDF layout/rebuild review.

reader_review.md.text:
# Full Introduction independent reader review — first candidate

Actor: /root/clean_reader_0611r2. Read-only review of all five prose paragraphs, N01–N23 in both languages, against both old Introduction texts. No repository edits. This is a source-text reader review pending compiled-render review; it is NOT a visual acceptance of the new manuscript.

Actual reference: Token-Picker: Accelerating Attention in Text Generation with Minimized Memory Transfer via Probability Estimation, author version arXiv:2407.15131v1, 21 July2024, DOI10.1145/3649329.3655953. Actual local PDF SHA256 `9a3b476481d6ff5e33b3dd21adf86022f5485f8718df4894bec4ab3280f03486`. Read extracted physicalpage1 and actually opened reference-p1.png, including full §1 Introduction across both columns. No claim to read its other pages. Best-paper designation supplied by parent; this reader did not independently browse the award source.

## Overall judgment

The candidate materially improves the narrative over the old text: computational tension appears immediately, closest prior cascade is acknowledged before its limitation, two different access constraints motivate the mechanism, and the ending preserves unfavorable results. It is recognizably research prose rather than an audit checklist. Its claim boundary still needs three short corrections below. The scientific validity of numbers/code is owned by the independent science review; readability is not validation.

The reference's functional progression is application importance → autoregressive memory bottleneck → prior pruning limitation → adaptive mechanism and memory strategy → bounded contributions with measurements. The candidate follows an appropriate analogous problem/gap/mechanism/contribution order, but its different mechanism and limited evidence remain explicit. I observed no distinctive phrase/sentence copying from the actually read reference paragraph. This is a bounded comparison, not a universal plagiarism certification.

## Must-fix before acceptance

1. **N07, exact object of the extrema bound.** Old text specifies individual unquantized token scores; candidate calls it merely an upper bound in scoring coordinates. A reader can carry that statement to the later quantized/full-dimensional scoring. Restore the object, without adding a long disclaimer: EN “sign-aware extrema provide a potentially loose upper bound on individual unquantized token scores in the same coordinates”; ZH “符号感知极值则给出相同坐标下未量化单词元分数的上界，但该界可能较松”. The sentence's final page-mass distinction can remain.
2. **N12, nominal capacity is not unconditional retained support.** “regional reservations retain capacity for both” / “为两侧保留容量” is too categorical immediately before N14 and given the paper's scarce-support and zero-far-slot cases. Use EN “explicit regional quotas can reserve nominal capacity for each region” / ZH “显式区域配额可以分别预留两侧的名义容量”. N14 then distinguishes which stage has the reservation. This avoids sounding like final far-token coverage is already guaranteed.
3. **N23, restore the actual evidence requirement.** Candidate coverage plus selector overhead alone cannot establish task quality or complete-request latency. The last sentence currently ends on those proxies and loses the old explicit missing matched evaluation. Suggested EN: “A quality--latency benefit for the compact 4/128-protection design therefore remains unestablished: it requires matched task-quality and complete-request measurements that include representation preparation, maintenance and selection.” ZH: “因此，紧凑4/128保护设计的质量--时延收益仍未确立：需要匹配的任务质量与完整请求测量，并计入表示准备、维护和选择成本。” This is a scientific boundary, not a demand to add experiments.

## Sentence functions and reader observations

|ID|Function / judgment|
|---|---|
|N01|Establishes growing attention history; clear entry to problem.|
|N02|Introduces selector overhead; “reduces the selected history” could become “restricts attention to selected history tokens” for more idiomatic English, optional.|
|N03|Sets fixed-budget quality/cost objective; useful and not a measured claim.|
|N04|States the design tension; EN/ZH convey the same emphasis.|
|N05|Attributes the cascade to AsyncTLS; prevents implied invention of cascade.|
|N06|Identifies coarse-stage candidate-loss risk; leads naturally to diagnostic.|
|N07|Explains score-target mismatch; restore precise bound object (must-fix1).|
|N08|Provides one diagnostic count; numbers are tied to figure/reference.|
|N09|Makes count-versus-mass inversion intelligible, rather than a naked metric list.|
|N10|Limits diagnostic to access, preserves nonquality interpretation.|
|N11|Transitions from scoring to regional capacity.|
|N12|Contrasts global allocation and regional reservation; needs nominal qualification.|
|N13|Gives mean change and adverse43/128 observations together; do not drop the latter.|
|N14|States the two-stage capacity gap; key bridge to method.|
|N15|Names the two-control formulation at suitable abstraction.|
|N16|Explains shared complete RoPE pairs and regional page eligibility.|
|N17|Explains protection, remaining token quotas and final full-dimensional attention. “one final attention operation” reads as merging selected support, not one operation shared by all Q heads; later method should retain per-Q-head detail.|
|N18|States narrower scoring does not remove full-history L2 work; central cost caveat.|
|N19|Contains the optional gate without making it a validated contribution.|
|N20|Summarizes formulation, capacity analysis and separated evaluation questions. Evaluation is descriptive rather than mechanism isolation; N22 appropriately qualifies it.|
|N21|Adds positive and negative model-specific outcomes; dense but intelligible. Optional replace “favors” with “reports an AVG0.99 points higher” to avoid winner language. Do not combine the two models or make them paired.|
|N22|Explicitly denies mechanism isolation and retains slower sparse decoding; necessary.|
|N23|Should close on matched quality/full-request evidence, not candidate-coverage/overhead proxies (must-fix3).|

## Bilingual flow and economy

English and Chinese share the same23 functions and limitations. Chinese “候选能否进入后续筛选” repeats at N10/N11, but it is a coherent transition rather than a must-fix. N21 contains model names, length, task count, beta settings and two deltas; one sentence is approaching overload. Keeping the negative delta and the slower-decode sentence is preferable to adding another summary of all metrics. The introduction no longer uses Fig1(c)/(d) as direct proof of low-frequency superiority or gate safety; those panels retain their explicit limitations in the unchanged caption. No new missing causal bridge is introduced by not listing every panel in the prose.

Pending: author fixes, revised source hash verification, and actual compiled-page visual review. This report alone does not accept final PDFs or the entire45-page artifact set.

# Introduction final independent reader review

Actor: /root/clean_reader_0611r2. Verdict: PASS for revised Introduction text and the specifically reviewed changed pages; not a full-artifact47-page visual certification.

## Actual frozen inputs and coverage

EN current PDF SHA256 `fc3172e1a70003aa2809164ba7ff896904a6dd0993b776c3d9093f257a61b260`,6 pages; ZH `9546062715997a88eeaf775c6ef757d47a8ac1c79e8f08c3b840946c5d742ab8`,6 pages. Re-read all23 candidate sentence pairs and verified each exact string appears in current source. Hashes are in reader_final_hashes.json; PDF inputs in reader_final_inputs.json.

Actual final visual read: EN physical1,2,3,5 and ZH1,2,3,4,5, each separately opened at RGB108dpi, gray108dpi, RGB72dpi and gray72dpi =9 pages/36 final images, generated directly by this reader from those frozen current PDFs into reader-final-render. Additionally opened baseline ENp1/ZHp1 RGB108dpi for visual comparison, and current PPTp14/p16 RGB72dpi. Total authoritative final/old/PPT images =40. No montage used. Old residual ENp6/7 were not used. Initial provided images that mixed snapshots are excluded from final coverage.

PPT PDF SHA256 `faaae3178c1d4acaf1a87948c0bd6753e1c12511cd5999132af6ff82444c63fb`. Text-only semantic checks on slides2,3,5,8,12,14,16,17; visual checks only14/16 this pass. Supplement PDFs are reported unchanged9/9 pages by parent/comparison record; this pass did not visually reread them and does not borrow the earlier8/8-page review as coverage of these new files.

## Text and scientific-boundary closure

N07 now specifies unquantized token scores in scoring coordinates; it no longer implies a bound on arbitrary quantized/full-dimensional scores. N12 now says regional quotas can reserve nominal capacity, compatible with later zero-far/insufficient-support caveats. N23 explicitly requires matched task-quality and complete-request measurements including preparation, maintenance and selection. All three prior must-fix items are closed in both source and visible PDF text.

The shorter N05 retains AsyncTLS attribution and coarse-to-fine order. N20 keeps formulation, joint capacity analysis and separated evaluation axes without claiming isolated mechanism gain. N21 keeps the8B allocation comparison distinct from the32B sparse/dense comparison and retains1.58-point deficit. N22 still retains slower sparse decoding. The argument remains problem → selector cost/access gap → page-score and regional-capacity diagnostics → coupled mechanism → contributions and bounded evidence. No new numeric or causal claim was introduced by the shortening. This is a reader conclusion; numerical/code validity remains the science review's remit.

The final Introduction does not read as an audit checklist. The count/mass example explains an inversion rather than accumulating unexplained numbers. It uses research-specific sentences, with no distinctive sentence copying from the actually read Token-Picker author-v1 physicalpage1 (reference identity/hash in reader_review.md). Chinese N07's “分数的、可能较松的上界” is slightly heavy but unambiguous and not a required rewrite. No remaining must-fix text issue identified.

## Page findings

ENp1: complete new introduction with ordinary two-column continuation, no truncation or glyph loss. ENp2: four-panel diagnostic and dense caption, subsequent shared-coordinates/budget headings and equations intact. ENp3: architecture, budget formulas and GQA/gate discussion readable. ENp5: model-quality figure, timing, limitations/conclusion retain negative results and scope captions.

ZHp1: full new introduction and continuation into related work/method intact. ZHp2: diagnostics, formulas and nominal-capacity caveat intact. ZHp3: architecture, GQA, parameter table and settings; no collisions. ZHp4: quality/timing figures and evaluation text remain within margins. ZHp5: limitations/conclusion/AI disclosure occupy left column with large deliberate right/lower whitespace; not a missing-content artifact observed. No blocking overlap, clipping, missing glyph or new unreadable annotation found.72dpi figures/captions are dense and benefit from zoom; this is screen-scale inspection, not physical-printer certification. GrayFigure1 loses color contrast but retains patterned legend, line styles and positional labels.

PPT14/16 retains different-scorer8B qualification,32B prediction-replay gap, historical128K negative example,1.58 deficit and lack of noninferiority/whole-cost evidence. Slides2/17 expressly retain missing matched validation, and slide8 uses nominal slots. New intro therefore does not require a new semantic claim on the deck based on the inspected content. The deck is not visually reaccepted in full by this pass.

## Found and resolved review-input problem

The initial supplied render folder mixed snapshots: ENp2 RGB108/72 showed continuation “with protected positions...” under Fig1, whereas same-page gray showed the finalized shared-coordinate heading directly. Parent confirmed the renderer only overwrote differing modes and left older images for unchanged modes. I stopped reliance on that folder and regenerated every final-mode image directly from the current PDFs under the independent reader-final-render directory, then opened all36. Parent reports correcting its renderer separately; I did not review that code and do not claim its tests passed. The historical mixed-input failure is preserved here, not silently relabeled a pass.

No manuscript mutation or compilation performed by this reader; only PDF rendering and private reports. Acceptance is bound to the exact hashes above.
